cards.prompt: In ASP.NET Core MVC, what two EF Core CLI commands create a migration named InitialCreate and apply it to the database?
cards.answer:
dotnet ef migrations add InitialCreate
dotnet ef database update
cards.explanation: migrations add scaffolds the C# Up()/Down() snapshot files; database update executes pending migrations against the configured DbContext connection string.
